# Rule 2.2 - Metagaming
Usage of out-of-character information, such as knowledge on antagonists, the specific mechanics that antagonists operate with, communicating outside of the game (metacomming), and acting upon other collected knowledge regarding the game or round that your character would not know is prohibited.
## Precedents
- Preparing for [textlink="Nuclear Operatives" link="NuclearOperatives"] because the shift has been quiet for the first twenty minutes. - Assuming that a player is a [textlink="Thief" link="Thieves"] because they stole an item from you. (You can still respond appropriately to getting robbed.) - Seeing someone kill someone is a murder, not a clear sign that there are multiple [textlink="sleeper agents" link="Traitors"] performing objectives on station. Assume crime is domestic unless it is extremely apparent it is not.
